scripts.clean: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const path=require('path');const root='behaviors/scripts';const exts=new Set(['.js','.js.map','.d.ts']);const walk=(d)=>{if(!fs.existsSync(d))return;for(const e of fs.readdirSync(d,{withFileTypes:true})){const p=path.join(d,e.name);if(e.isDirectory())walk(p);else if(exts.has(e.name.endsWith('.d.ts')?'.d.ts':path.extname(e.name)))fs.rmSync(p,{force:true});}};walk(root);"
scripts.rebuild: npm run clean && npm run build
